question: Who wrote the three-volume history of Akbar's reign?
solution: The correct answer is __**Abul Fazl**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Abul Fazl** was a prominent courtier, historian, and writer in the court of Mughal Emperor Akbar. • He authored the **three-volume history** of Akbar's reign titled **Akbarnama**, which is one of the most celebrated chronicles of the Mughal era. • The **Akbarnama** is divided into three parts: the first part deals with Akbar's ancestors, the second part focuses on Akbar's reign, and the third part is the **Ain-i-Akbari**, a detailed account of the administration and culture of the empire. • Abul Fazl's work is considered an **authentic and detailed source** of Mughal history and administration during Akbar's reign. • He was also known for his literary style and contributions to Persian literature. He played a significant role in shaping Akbar's policies and was one of the **Nine Gems (Navratnas)** of Akbar's court.
